name: SOC Framework - Microsoft Entra ID
description: SOC Framework correlation rules for Microsoft Entra ID sign-in events. Detects failed authentication, risky sign-ins, and suspicious identity activity from the msft_azure_ad_raw dataset (Office 365 data source, Microsoft Graph API). XSIAM native behavioral identity analytics also fire on this data after baseline learning; these rules fire on field values immediately.
author: Palo Alto Networks
